name: Saddleworth High Moor
blurb: Four thousand acres of heather, drained for grouse and fenced against walkers. The keepers' hut has a stuffed fox in it with a look of lasting resentment.
ranger: Don't touch the gate. Actually, do. It's yours. The previous owner's keepers will have left the gate in a state of loud disapproval.
There's green coming through where the grips were blocked. The water is staying put, which is more than the last keeper did.
Peregrines, if you can believe it. Up on the edge, looking at the hares like a man looking at a menu. The old shoot would have had a word.
Listen to that. Curlew, grouse and nobody shooting at either. Thank you. The walkers will want a plaque, and they'll want it to say something rude about the Enclosure.
